source.title: VAT, GST or sales tax standard rate, read on the tax authority's own page

rows.note: The page reads: "VAT is levied at the standard rate of 15% on the supply of goods and services by registered vendors." The page also records that the rises to 15.5% (1 May 2025) and 16% (1 April 2026) proposed in the March 2025 budget were withdrawn: the rate stays 15%.
The page reads: "4.1 General Rate Currently, the rate is 7 percent."
The page reads: "The current GST rate in Singapore is 9%." The page's history of rates ends with 8% from 1 Jan 2023 to 31 Dec 2023; it does not print the 9% rate's start date.

rows.measure: sales tax, standard rate (Sales Tax Act 1990, section 3)
rows.note: The page reads: "the standa rate of sales tax has been increased from 17% to 18%" Read in the FBR's 2023 circular (the quote keeps the PDF's own typo 'standa'); a later change would be in a later Finance Act.
